blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models incur substantial training and inference costs in personalized search and recommendation, as growing interaction histories lengthen request inputs and repeatedly expose the same item text to the model. We propose \textbf{C}omposable and \textbf{R}eusable \textbf{I}tem \textbf{M}emory (CRIM), a framework that separates item-level semantic encoding from request-level history modeling. A small set of learnable summary tokens compresses each item into compact continuous memories, while segment-level readout tokens (REC tokens) introduce predictive supervision within the interaction history. These memories are independent of users and queries and can therefore be reused across requests. At inference time, CRIM composes cached memories in interaction order and incorporates an optional query to produce a personalized retrieval representation, reducing repeated item-text encoding while retaining request-dependent contextual modeling. We further introduce a joint training mechanism that combines cached memories with sampled live re-encoding. Re-encoding only a few history items per request allows the retrieval objective to jointly optimize the item and request encoders at limited computational cost, while periodic cache refreshes maintain consistency. Extensive evaluation and cost analysis on MovieLens-1M, Qilin, and our new LazSeq dataset show that CRIM achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance with substantially lower inference costs at the same backbone scale, while limiting item re-encoding during joint training. We will publicly release our code and dataset.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型在个性化搜索和建议方面需要大量的培训和推论费用,因为越来越多的互动历史要求投入,并且一再将同一项目文本暴露在模型中。 我们提议\textbf{C}可使用和\textbf{R}可使用\textbf{I}tem\textbf{M}emory(CRIM),这个框架将项目级语义编码与请求级历史建模区分开来. 一小组可学习的汇总符号将每个项目压缩成紧凑的连续记忆,而分层读出符号(REC acident)则引入了互动历史中的预测性监督. 这些记忆独立于用户和查询,因此可以在请求中重复使用。 推算时,CRIM按交互顺序编译缓存记忆并包含一个可选的查询,以产生个性化的检索表示,减少重复的项-文本编码,同时保留依赖请求的背景模型. 我们进一步引入了联合培训机制,将缓存记忆与抽样直播再编码相结合。 每个请求只重新编码了几个历史项目,使得检索目标能够以有限的计算成本共同优化项目并请求编码器,而定期缓存刷新则保持了一致性. 对MovieLens-1M,Qilin,和我们新的LazSeq数据集的广泛评价和成本分析显示,CRIM实现了最先进的检索性能,在相同的主干尺度上,推论成本大大降低,同时限制项目在联合培训中重新编码. 我们将公开发布我们的代码和数据集。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Personalized Web search and recommendation retrieve relevant items from large catalogs using a user’s ordered interaction history and, when available, a current query. Large language models provide rich semantic representations of items and queries, but growing histories increase both training and inference costs. Repeatedly encoding the same items across users and requests adds further overhead. Efficient personalized retrieval therefore requires addressing three challenges: reusing item semantics while retaining request-dependent contextual modeling; preserving both semantic information and interaction patterns in compressed representations; and jointly optimizing item and retrieval encoders when cached representations reduce the amount of differentiable computation.
blocks.zh: 个人化 网络搜索和推荐从大型目录中检索相关项目,使用用户所订购的交互历史,并在可用时使用当前查询。 大型语言模型为项目和查询提供了丰富的语义表述,但日益增长的历史既增加了培训和推论成本. 在用户中重复编码同样的项目,请求会增加更多的间接费用. 因此,高效的个性化检索需要应对三个挑战:在保留基于请求的背景模型的同时重新使用项目语义;在压缩表达方式中保留语义信息和交互模式;在缓存表达方式减少不同计算量时共同优化项目和检索编码器。

blocks.en: Existing methods address different aspects of these challenges. Recformer ( Li et al., 2023 ) jointly models item text and interaction sequences, while processing history text for each request. Token Factory ( Chen et al., 2026 ) converts heterogeneous features into soft tokens and compresses recommendation inputs, and ICAE ( Ge et al., 2024 ) learns compact memories through autoencoding and language modeling. These approaches demonstrate the value of compression. For personalized retrieval, however, an item representation must also remain useful when composed into different histories, and text reconstruction alone does not directly supervise interaction patterns. Representation caching offers a complementary way to reduce repeated computation. GNNAutoScale ( Fey et al., 2021 ) , for example, reuses historical embeddings in graph neural networks. Applying caching to language-model-based item encoding requires coordinating encoder updates with the gradient paths available through cached representations, without allowing full-history re-encoding to consume the savings from reuse.
blocks.zh: 现有方法处理这些挑战的不同方面。 Recformer (Li et al., 2023) 联合模型项目文本和交互序列,同时处理每个请求的历史文本. Token Factory (Chen et al., 2026) 将各种特性转换为软符并压缩推荐输入,ICAE (Ge et al., 2024) 通过自动编码和语言建模学习紧凑的记忆. 这些方法证明了压缩的价值. 然而,对于个性化检索而言,项目表述在编成不同历史时也必须继续有用,文本重建本身并不直接监督互动模式。 代表缓存是减少重复计算的一种补充方式。 例如,GNNAuto Scale(Fey等人,2021年)在图神经网络中重新使用历史嵌入. 在基于语言模型的项目编码中应用缓存需要协调编码器更新与通过缓存表达式提供的梯度路径,而不能允许完整的历史重编码来消耗再利用的节省.

blocks.en: Our central idea is to separate stable item semantics from dynamic request context. We propose C omposable and R eusable I tem M emory (CRIM). An item memory encoder (IME) independently maps each item to a compact block of continuous memories shared across users and requests. A request encoder (RE) composes these blocks in interaction order and incorporates an optional query to generate a personalized retrieval representation. This design moves repeated item-text encoding offline while preserving contextual modeling of the current history and information need. Preserving item-text semantics allows retrieval to use the LLM’s pretrained semantic knowledge alongside learned interaction patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们的中心思想是将稳定的项目语义与动态请求上下文分开. 我们提议C可移动性和可使用性I tem M emory (CRIM)。 一个项内存编码器(IME)独立地将每个项映射到用户和请求之间共享的连续记忆的紧凑块. 请求编码器(RE)按交互顺序组成这些块,并包含一个可选查询,以生成个性化的检索表示. 这种设计将重复的项-文本编码移离线下,同时保留当前历史和信息需要的背景模型. 保存项- 文本语义允许检索使用 LLM 预先训练的语义知识, 并同时使用学到的交互模式 。

blocks.en: To support semantic compression and sequence learning together, CRIM combines learnable summary tokens with segment-level readout tokens, termed REC tokens. Summary tokens encode each item’s semantics into a small number of continuous vectors. REC tokens read out intermediate history prefixes to predict subsequent interactions, introducing supervision throughout the sequence. We further develop a joint training mechanism that combines cached memories with sampled live re-encoding. Only a few history positions are re-encoded for each request, allowing retrieval gradients to update the IME through those positions. The remaining positions reuse cached memories and participate in RE training. Periodic refreshes keep the memory cache aligned with the evolving encoder. This mechanism allows item memories to adapt to the retrieval objective while limiting the cost of re-encoding long histories.
blocks.zh: 为了支持语义压缩和序列学习一起进行,CRIM将可学习的简要符号与段级读出符号(REC sords)结合,称为RECs. 汇总符号将每个项目的语义编码为少量连续向量. REC符读出中间历史前缀以预测后续的相互作用,引入整个序列的监督. 我们进一步发展联合培训机制,将缓存记忆与抽样直播重编码相结合。 每个请求只有几个历史位置被重新编码,允许检索梯度通过这些位置更新IME. 其余位置再利用缓存记忆并参与RE训练. 定期刷新保持内存缓存与不断发展的编码器保持一致. 这种机制允许项目记忆适应检索目标,同时限制重新编码长历史的成本.

blocks.en: We introduce LazSeq, a benchmark for query-conditioned retrieval with approximately 30,000 requests, a shared catalog of 49,993 distinct items, and histories of up to 500 interactions. Together with MovieLens-1M (ML1M) ( Harper and Konstan, 2015 ) and Qilin ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , it supports an extensive evaluation across retrieval methods and task settings. CRIM achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance. Compared with the Qwen3-Embedding-4B baseline ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , it improves Recall@100 by 2.49% on LazSeq and 33.61% on ML1M, and NDCG@100 by 5.64% on Qilin, all measured as relative improvements. As shown in Figure 1 , CRIM combines strong retrieval quality with lower latency and fewer serving tokens on LazSeq at the same backbone scale. Our cost analysis relates offline investment and request computation to the volume of requests that reuse item memories.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了LazSeq, 一个有查询条件的检索基准, 大约有30,000个请求, 共有49,993个不同的项目, 以及多达500个互动的历史。 它与MovieLens-1M(ML1M)(Harper和Konstan,2015年)和Qilin(Chen等人,2025年)一起,支持跨检索方法和任务设置的广泛评价. CRIM实现最先进的检索性能. 与Qwen3-Embedding-4B基线(Zhang等人,2025年)相比,它改进了LazSeq的Recall@100和ML1M的33.49%,以及Qilin的NDCG@100和5.64%,均被测量为相对改进. 如图1所示,CRIM在拉兹塞克上将强检索质量与更低的延迟和更少的服务令牌以相同的主干尺度结合. 我们的费用分析涉及离线投资,要求计算重复使用项目记忆的请求数量。

blocks.en: Our contributions are fourfold: • Composable and reusable item memory. We propose a novel framework that separates item-level semantic encoding from request-level history modeling, enabling reuse across requests while retaining personalized contextual modeling. • Semantic compression with sequence supervision. We combine summary tokens for compact item representations with REC tokens that introduce predictive supervision within interaction histories. • Efficient joint training. We combine cached memories with sampled live re-encoding, allowing item memories to adapt to the retrieval objective while controlling re-encoding costs. • LazSeq and comprehensive evaluation. We introduce a long-history retrieval dataset and evaluate retrieval quality and computational efficiency across three datasets, supported by a cost analysis of memory reuse.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有四重:可编译和可重复使用的项目记忆。 我们提出了一个新颖的框架,将项目层面语义编码与请求层面的历史建模区分开来,使请求之间能够重复使用,同时保留个性化的背景建模。 • 语义压缩和序列监督。 我们把紧凑项目表述的简要标志与在互动历史中引入预测性监督的REC标志结合起来。 • 有效的联合培训。 我们把缓存的记忆与抽样的直播重编码结合起来,允许项目记忆适应检索目标,同时控制重编码成本. • LazSeq和综合评价。 我们引入了一个历史悠久的检索数据集,并评价三个数据集的检索质量和计算效率,辅以内存再利用的成本分析.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Recformer ( Li et al., 2023 ) organizes item attributes as text sequences and jointly learns language representations and interaction patterns. TIGER ( Rajput et al., 2023 ) maps items to semantic identifiers and autoregressively predicts the next item. GEMS ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) unifies search and recommendation through gradient subspace decomposition that coordinates task-specific optimization signals. Related adaptation methods include LiRA ( Li et al., 2026c ) , which aligns low-resource languages in a shared semantic space for multilingual retrieval, and AgentDet ( Li et al., 2026b ) , which coordinates detection agents through a shared blackboard and knowledge base for zero-/few-shot object detection. CRIM focuses on repeated item encoding in long histories, using shared item memories to support request-dependent composition and integrate history with an optional query in a dense retrieval framework.
blocks.zh: Recformer (Li et al., 2023) 组织项目属性作为文本序列,并共同学习语言表达和相互作用模式. TIGER(Rajput等人,2023年)将项目映射到语义识别器上,并自动预测下一个项目. GEMS(Zhao等人,2026年)通过梯度子空间分解统一搜索与推荐,协调任务特定优化信号. 相关的适应方法包括:LIRA(Li et al.,2026c.)在共享语义空间对低资源语言进行调和,以进行多语种检索;Agent Det(Li et al.,2026b.)通过共享黑板和知识库协调检测剂,用于零/few-shot对象检测. CRIM专注于长历史中重复的项目编码,利用共享的项目记忆支持请求依赖的构成,并将历史与一个可选查询整合在一个密集的检索框架中.

blocks.en: Prefix-tuning ( Li and Liang, 2021 ) and prompt tuning ( Lester et al., 2021 ) learn continuous task prompts. Context compression instead encodes input content: LLMLingua ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) prunes prompt tokens, while continuous compressors retain information from long text in a small set of vectors. ICAE ( Ge et al., 2024 ) learns compact memory slots through autoencoding and language modeling, while EBMC ( Dai et al., 2025 ) pretrains a decoupled compressor using text reconstruction and completion. For industrial recommendation, Token Factory ( Chen et al., 2026 ) maps heterogeneous features to soft tokens and compresses behavioral inputs. Dual-purpose Semantic IDs ( Li et al., 2026a ) combine discrete encoding with on-demand vector reconstruction to reduce item representation storage and transfer costs. CRIM uses individual items as the unit of reuse: summary tokens retain item semantics, and REC tokens introduce prediction objectives within interaction histories so that compact memories support composition and retrieval across users.

ICAE(Ge et al., 2024)通过自动编码和语言建模来学习紧凑的内存槽,而EBMC(Dai et al., 2025)则利用文本重建与完成来预留一个解耦的压缩机. 就工业建议而言,Token Factory(Chen等人,2026年)将各种特征映射到软符上,并压缩行为输入. 双目的语义ID(Li等人,2026a)将离散编码与点播矢量重建相结合,以减少物品表达存储和转让成本. CRIM使用单个项目作为再利用的单位:摘要符号保留项目语义学,REC符号在交互历史中引入预测目标,以便紧凑记忆支持各个用户的构成和检索.

blocks.en: Caching reduces repeated computation, but its effectiveness depends on gradient paths and representation refresh frequency. Graph Segment Training ( Cao et al., 2023 ) backpropagates through sampled graph segments while reusing historical embeddings for the remaining segments. REST ( Xue et al., 2025 ) reduces representation staleness by separating forward refreshes from parameter updates. CRIM applies partial differentiable computation and caching to language-model-based item memory. Each request re-encodes only a small sample of history positions, allowing the retrieval objective to jointly optimize the IME and RE; periodic refreshes maintain cache consistency.
blocks.zh: 缓存会减少重复计算,但其有效性取决于梯度路径和表示更新频率. 图段训练(Cao等人,2023年)通过取样的图段进行反扩散,同时为其余部分重新使用历史嵌入。 REST(薛等人,2025年)通过将前置刷新与参数更新区分开来,减少了表示的停滞. CRIM对基于语言模型的项目内存应用部分不同的计算和缓存. 每个请求只重新编码少量历史位置样本,允许检索目标共同优化IME和RE;定期刷新保持缓存一致性.

We first perform semantic pretraining on the item catalog through reconstruction. A decoding sequence is appended after the summary tokens, with the item title as the reconstruction target. A restricted attention mask allows decoding positions to access only the summary positions and preceding decoding tokens, blocking direct access to the source text and identity prefix. Consequently, source information must pass through the summary tokens to support reconstruction.

blocks.en: 3.3. Sequence-Aware Memory Composition
blocks.zh: 3.3. 序列-识别内存组成

blocks.en: Independent item memories retain item semantics, while personalized retrieval additionally requires modeling interaction order and evolving interests. The RE therefore composes memories chronologically and uses segment-level supervision to learn representations of different history prefixes.
blocks.zh: 独立的项目记忆保留了项目语义,而个性化的检索额外需要建模交互顺序和不断发展的兴趣. 因此RE按时间顺序构成记忆,并使用分层监督来学习不同历史前缀的表示.

blocks.en: The memory vectors enter the RE as continuous input embeddings through a learnable residual mapping. For the k k -th memory vector z i , k z_{i,k} of item i i , (4) z ¯ i , k = z i , k + W in ​ z i , k + a k , \bar{z}_{i,k}=z_{i,k}+W_{\mathrm{in}}z_{i,k}+a_{k}, where W in W_{\mathrm{in}} is a residual projection and a k a_{k} is a learnable within-item memory-position embedding. Both are initialized to zero, so the RE initially receives the original memories and gradually learns an input representation suited to history modeling.

blocks.en: We divide the history into J = ⌈ N / b ⌉ J=\lceil N/b\rceil contiguous segments of at most b b items. A shared set of learnable segment readout tokens, termed REC tokens, is inserted after each segment. History memories use causal attention. The REC tokens of segment j j can attend to all memories up to that segment and earlier REC tokens within the same readout block. Subsequent history memories, query tokens, and the final retrieval position do not attend to REC hidden states. This provides additional supervision positions while preserving direct interactions among history memories.

The final EOS hidden state passes through a representation adapter and normalization to produce u u . Inserting REC tokens does not advance the position indices of subsequent memories and query tokens, preserving their original positional relationships. The candidate branch reuses the RE’s language model to encode item text followed by EOS; a candidate-side representation adapter and normalization produce v i v_{i} .

blocks.en: 4.1. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1. 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on LazSeq, Qilin, and MovieLens-1M (ML1M). LazSeq and Qilin support query-conditioned personalized retrieval, where a model combines the user history and current query to predict a target item. ML1M supports sequential recommendation without an explicit query. Each request contains one target. History lengths are capped at 500 for LazSeq and 100 for Qilin and ML1M. All ML1M methods use the same request-level data protocol, without expanding history prefixes into additional training examples. Appendix A.2 gives dataset statistics, loading details, and checkpoint-selection protocols.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了LazSeq、Qilin和MovieLens-1M(ML1M)。 LazSeq和Qilin支持查询条件的个性化检索,其中一个模型结合用户历史和当前查询来预测一个目标项目. ML1M支持没有明确查询的顺序推荐. 每个请求都包含一个目标。 历史长度上限为拉兹塞克500,基林和ML1M100. 所有ML1M方法都使用相同的请求级数据协议,没有将历史前缀扩展为额外的训练实例. 附录A.2提供了数据集统计,加载细节,以及检查站-选择协议.

blocks.en: All baseline results are obtained from our own reproductions, and we will release the corresponding code. We compare three groups of methods. The ID-based group contains GRU4Rec ( Hidasi et al., 2016 ) , NARM ( Li et al., 2017 ) , STAMP ( Liu et al., 2018 ) , SASRec ( Kang and McAuley, 2018 ) , BERT4Rec ( Sun et al., 2019 ) , S3Rec ( Zhou et al., 2020 ) , LightSANs ( Fan et al., 2021 ) , SINE ( Tan et al., 2021 ) , and FEARec ( Du et al., 2023 ) . Generative retrieval and language-model recommendation methods include TIGER ( Rajput et al., 2023 ) , LlamaRec ( Yue et al., 2023 ) , GenSAR ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , and GEMS ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . The dense text encoders include GTE-1.5B ( Alibaba-NLP, 2024 ) , E5-Mistral-7B ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , Gemma3-4B (pretrained and instruction-tuned), Llama3.1-8B, Ministral-8B-Instruct, Phi-4-14B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and -4B. Qwen3-Embedding-4B shares CRIM’s backbone and is the main reference for examining memory compression and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 所有基准结果都来自我们自己的复制,我们将发布相应的代码. 我们比较了三组方法。 该ID基团包含GRU4Rec(Hidasi等人,2016年),NARM(Li等人,2017年),STAMP(Liu等人,2018年),SASRec(Kang and McAuley,2018年),BERT4Rec(Sun等人,2019年),S3Rec(周等人,2020年),LightSANs(Fan等人,2021年),SINE(Tan等人,2021年),FEAREC(Du等人,2023年). 基因检索和语言模型推荐方法包括TIGER(Rajput等人,2023年),LlamaRec(Yue等人,2023年),Gensar(Shi等人,2025年)和GEMS(Zhao等人,2026年). 密集文本编码器包括GTE-1.5B(阿里巴巴-NLP,2024年),E5-Mistral-7B(王等人,2024年),Gemma3-4B(预训和指令调制),Llama3.1-8B,Ministal-8B-Instruct,Phi-4-14B,Qune3-4B,以及Qune3-Embedding-0.6B和-4B. Qune3-Embedding-4B共享CRIM的骨干,是检查内存压缩和计算成本的主要参考.

blocks.en: ID-based methods use history item IDs. CRIM and query-aware dense encoders receive history item text and the query on LazSeq and Qilin. TIGER, LlamaRec, GenSAR, and GEMS use implementations adapted to the current retrieval tasks. Dense results use the corresponding LoRA-trained checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 基于ID的方法使用历史项目ID. CRIM和有查询意识的密集编码器接收历史项目文本和关于LazSeq和Qilin的查询. TIGER、LlamaRec、GenSAR和GEMS使用适应当前检索任务的执行。 通过相应的LORA培训的检查站,取得了显著成果。

blocks.en: We evaluate retrieval over the complete valid item catalog, retaining items that already occur in the user history. Recall@ K K and NDCG@ K K measure target retrieval and ranking quality. Results are averaged across test requests. We additionally report MRR@100, assigning zero to targets ranked below 100, and full-catalog MRR where available. Beam-limited runs without complete ranks do not report full-catalog MRR.
blocks.zh: 我们对完整有效的项目目录进行检索评价,保留用户历史中已经出现的项目。 召回@ K K K 和 NDCG@ KK测量目标检索和排名质量. 测试请求的结果平均。 我们另外报告MRR@100,将零分配给低于100的目标,并在有完整目录的情况下报告MRR。 没有完整排位的Beam有限运行不报告全目录MRR.

blocks.en: We train with eight NVIDIA A100-80GB GPUs. CRIM uses Qwen3-Embedding-4B in BF16 with LoRA rank 16 for both encoders. A shared set of K = 4 K=4 summary tokens produces four memory vectors per item. Each history segment contains b = 4 b=4 items followed by R = 4 R=4 REC tokens. The re-encoding budget is κ = 8 \kappa=8 on LazSeq and κ = 4 \kappa=4 on Qilin and ML1M, and item memories and trainable candidate caches are refreshed after each epoch. Semantic pretraining uses a KL weight of 0.1. Joint training uses a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , temperature 0.05, segment loss weight 1, and semantic reconstruction weight 0.1.
blocks.zh: 我们用8个NVIDIA A100-80GB GPU进行训练. CRIM在BF16中使用Quen3-Embedding-4B,Lora排名为16,两种编码器都使用. 一套共享的K=4K=4汇总符号,每个项目产生四个内存矢量. 每个历史段包含b=4 b=4项,后面是R=4 R=4 REC标志。 重新编码的预算在LazSeq上为=8\kappa=8,在Qilin和ML1M上为=4\kappa=4,每个纪元后都会刷新项目记忆和可训练候选缓存. 语义预训使用KL重0.1. 联合训练采用10−4 10^{-4},温度0.05,段减重1,语义重建重0.1.

blocks.en: On LazSeq and Qilin, joint training runs for at most three epochs with a global batch size of 64. The retrieval loss is computed within logical groups of at most eight target items. ML1M uses at most ten epochs with batch size eight, a mean readout from the final REC block, fixed pooled candidate encodings, and an additional title-generation loss. Its retrieval negatives also include catalog-sampled items. Table 5 in Appendix A.2 gives the full configurations.
blocks.zh: 在LazSeq和Qilin,联合培训最多为三个世纪,全球批量64个。 检索损失按8个目标项目的逻辑组计算。 ML1M最多使用10个批量尺寸为8的纪元,从最终的REC块中平均读出,固定集合候选编码,以及额外的标题生成损失. 它的检索负数还包括分类样本. 附录A.2表5列出了完整的配置。

blocks.en: 4.2. The LazSeq Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.2. 拉兹塞克数据集

blocks.en: We construct LazSeq for personalized search with long interaction histories. Each request contains an ordered history, a current query, and a target item; history and target items have shared IDs and titles. Repeated interactions are retained. A shared item catalog supports the study of semantic reuse across requests.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了LazSeq, 进行个性化的搜索, 具有长期的互动历史。 每个请求包含一个命令历史,一个当前查询,以及一个目标项目;历史和目标项目共享了ID和标题. 重复的相互作用被保留. 共享项目目录支持研究各种请求的语义重复使用。

blocks.en: LazSeq contains approximately 30,000 requests with up to 500 history interactions each. Its shared catalog comprises 49,993 distinct items from history and target positions. CRIM uses 23,999 training requests, 3,000 validation requests, and 2,999 test requests. Fixed request splits and a title catalog support reproducible comparisons. Figure 6 in Appendix A.1 illustrates query–history filtering and catalog construction; the appendix also details the request splits.
blocks.zh: LazSeq包含约30,000项请求,每个请求最多有500个历史互动. 其共用目录包括49 993个与历史和目标位置不同的项目。 CRIM使用23,999个培训请求,3000个验证请求,以及2,999个测试请求. 固定请求分割和标题目录支持可复制比较. 附录A.1中的图6说明了查询-历史过滤和编目构建;附录还详细列出了请求的划分。

blocks.en: 4.3. Retrieval Results and Comparative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3. 检索结果和比较分析

blocks.en: Tables 1 – 3 compare CRIM with sequential, generative, and dense retrieval methods. We report Recall, NDCG, MRR@100, and full-catalog MRR, with cutoffs shown in the tables. Relative improvements use unrounded results. Appendix A.4 compares method groups and additional ranking cutoffs.
blocks.zh: 表1–3比较了CRIM与顺序法,基因法,和密集检索法. 我们报告 " 召回 " 、 " NDCG " 、 " MRR@100 " 和 " 全目录 " 的 " MRR " ,表内列出截断点。 相对改进使用未四舍五入的结果。 附录A.4比较了方法组和额外的排名截断.

blocks.en: CRIM achieves the highest Recall@50, Recall@100, and Recall@1000, reaching 0.5835, 0.6969, and 0.9330, respectively. These values improve over the strongest baseline at each cutoff by 0.49%, 2.43%, and 0.83%: Qwen3-Embedding-4B at 50, GTE-1.5B at 100, and Phi-4 at 1000. CRIM ranks second at NDCG@50 and NDCG@100, reaching 0.2430 and 0.2614. At Recall@3000, it ranks second with 0.9737, following Phi-4 at 0.9750. Compared with Qwen3-Embedding-4B, CRIM improves Recall@50, @100, @1000, and @3000 by 0.49%, 2.49%, 1.67%, and 1.11%, respectively. These results show that four memory vectors per history item preserve the information needed for strong candidate retrieval over long histories.
blocks.zh: CRIM实现最高的Recall@50,Recall@100,和Recall@1000,分别达到0.5835,0.6969和0.9330. 这些数值在每次截断时比最强的基准值提高了0.49%、2.43%和0.83%:Qune3-Embedding-4B值50、GTE-1.5B值100和Phi-4值1000。 CRIM在NDCG@50和NDCG@100排名第二,达到0.2430和0.2614. 在Recall@3000上,它以0.9737位列第二,跟随Phi-4以0.9750位. 与Qwen3-Embedding-4B相比,CRIM将回召@50,@100,@1000和@300分别改进0.49%,2.49%,1.67%和1.11%. 这些结果表明,每个历史项目有四个内存矢量,在漫长的历史中保存强有力的候选人检索所需的信息。

blocks.en: CRIM achieves the best NDCG@10, NDCG@100, MRR@100, and full-catalog MRR. Relative to Qwen3-Embedding-4B, NDCG@10 rises from 0.4126 to 0.4434, NDCG@100 from 0.4518 to 0.4772, and full-catalog MRR from 0.3682 to 0.4059, corresponding to gains of 7.48%, 5.64%, and 10.23%. CRIM also exceeds GTE-1.5B, the strongest baseline for these three metrics, by 0.70%, 0.71%, and 1.96%.
blocks.zh: CRIM实现最佳NDCG@10,NDCG@100,MRR@100,以及全目录MRR. 相对于Qwen3-Embedding-4B,NDCG@10从0.4126升至0.4434,NDCG@100从0.4518升至0.4772,全目录的MRR从0.3682升至0.4059,收益率为7.48%,5.64%,10.23%. CRIM也超过了GTE-1.5B,这三种度量的最强基线,比0.70%,0.71%,1.96%.

blocks.en: Without an explicit query, CRIM leads all six reported metrics. Its Recall@10 of 0.1183 exceeds the strongest baseline, Ministral-8B-Instruct at 0.0719, by 64.52%. Recall@100 reaches 0.3782, improving over GTE-1.5B’s 0.2900 by 30.40% and over Qwen3-Embedding-4B by 33.61%. NDCG@100 reaches 0.1139, a 47.67% gain over the strongest baseline, Qwen3-Embedding-4B. NDCG@10, MRR@100, and full-catalog MRR are 0.0629, 0.0548, and 0.0564, respectively. These results demonstrate improvements in both candidate retrieval and ranking quality for history-only recommendation under the ML1M configuration.
blocks.zh: 在没有明确查询的情况下,CRIM领导所有6个报告的指标。 它的召回量为0.1183的@10,超过了最强基线,Ministry-8B-Instruct在0.0719,增加了64.52%. 回顾@100达到0.3782,比GTE-1.5B的0.290提高30.40%,比Qune3-Embedding-4B提高33.61%。 NDCG@100达到0.1139,超过最强基线的47.67%增益,Qune3-Embedding-4B. NDCG@10、MRR@100和全目录MRR分别为0.0629、0.0548和0.0564。 这些结果表明,在ML1M配置下,候选人检索和仅针对历史的建议的排名质量都有提高。

blocks.en: CRIM reduces mean latency to 90.76 ms from the dense reference’s 367.45 ms, a 4.05 × 4.05\times speedup. The 95th-percentile latency falls from 818.03 to 173.39 ms. Mean serving input length decreases from 5,020.36 to 966.62 positions, including REC tokens, the query, and template tokens, a reduction of 80.75%. CRIM is also faster than the 0.6B embedding baseline at 117.17 ms while achieving higher Recall@100. Independent item encoding therefore shifts substantial work out of the online request path.
blocks.zh: CRIM从密集参考的367.45 ms,一个4.05×4.05\时速加速,将平均耐力降低到90.76 ms. 第95个百分位的纬度从818.03米下降到173.39米. 平均输入长度从5 020.36降至966.62,包括REC标志、查询和模板标志,减少了80.75%。 CRIM还比0.6B嵌入基线快117.17 ms,同时实现更高的Recall@100. 因此,独立的项目编码将大量工作从在线请求路径转移。

blocks.zh: CRIM在Recall@100中超过该变体的1.03个百分点,在NDCG@100中超过0.77个百分点,在MRR@100中超过0.71个百分点. 因此,通过文本重建启动项目记忆,有利于随后的联合培训。

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: We presented CRIM, a personalized retrieval framework that separates reusable item semantics from request-dependent history modeling. Summary tokens compress items into continuous memories, and REC tokens provide predictive supervision within ordered histories. Cached memories and sampled live re-encoding jointly train the IME and RE with a small differentiable item-encoding budget. Across LazSeq, Qilin, and ML1M, CRIM achieves strong candidate recall and ranking quality. On LazSeq, it reduces serving input length by 80.75% and delivers a 4.05 × 4.05\times latency speedup over the same-scale dense reference.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了CRIM,一个个性化的检索框架,它把可重复使用的项目语义和依赖请求的历史模型区分开来. 摘要令牌将物品压缩成连续记忆,REC令牌在定点历史中提供预测性监督. 缓存的记忆和抽样的现场重新编码联合训练了IME和RE,并用一个小的不同项目编码预算. 横跨拉兹塞克,吉林,和ML1M,CRIM实现强候选人召回和排名质量. 在LazSeq上,它将服务输入长度缩短80.75%,并在相同比例的稠密参照物上提供4.05×4.05\时间的延迟速度.

blocks.en: We retain requests with at least 100 original interactions and a lexical query–history overlap of at least 0.5, keeping the most recent 500 history items. To compute overlap, the query is lowercased and split on whitespace, discarding tokens of length one. The score is the fraction of retained query tokens appearing in the concatenated recent history titles. Requests may target either an item already present in the history or a previously unseen item.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了至少100个原始互动请求,以及至少0.5个历史重叠的词汇查询,保留了最新的500个历史项目。 为计算重叠,查询在白空间上进行小写和分拆,丢弃长度1的符号. 分数是保留了近代史标题中出现的查询符的分数. 请求可以针对历史上已经存在的物品或以前未见的物品。

blocks.en: We aggregate eligible requests and count item occurrences in target and retained history positions. These frequencies determine the retained item set; requests are kept if their target belongs to this set. We then fill training, validation, and test splits in processed stream order at an approximate 8 : 1 : 1 8:1:1 ratio. Item frequencies are computed before splitting. The final shared catalog is the union of retained item IDs appearing in the three output splits. This request-level protocol provides a common candidate space across splits.
blocks.zh: 我们汇总了符合资格的要求,并统计了目标中的项目发生情况,并保留了历史位置。 这些频率决定了保留项集;如果目标属于此集,则请求保留. 然后,我们按大约8:1:1:1的比例在经过处理的流序中填充训练、验证和测试分数。 物品的频率在分离前计算。 最终的共享目录是三个输出分割中出现的保留项ID的结合. 这个请求级协议提供了跨分割的通用候选空间.

blocks.en: A.4. Additional Comparisons
blocks.zh: A.4. 其他比较

blocks.en: The method groups differ substantially. Among ID-based models, S3Rec has the highest Recall@100 at 0.1097. The adapted GenSAR implementation reaches 0.4308, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B reaches 0.6447, and CRIM reaches 0.6969. Methods using item text generally perform better in this query-conditioned setting.
blocks.zh: 方法分组差别很大。 在基于ID的模型中,S3Rec的Recall@100最高,为0.1097. 改造后的GESAR实施达到0.4308,Qune3-Embedding-0.6B达到0.6447,CRIM达到0.6969. 使用项目文本的方法通常在这个有查询条件的设置中表现更好。

blocks.en: On LazSeq, CRIM ranks second at NDCG@50 and NDCG@100 with 0.2430 and 0.2614, compared with 0.2458 and 0.2620 for Qwen3-Embedding-4B. The dense reference leads Recall@10 at 0.3390 versus 0.3204 for CRIM. CRIM combines higher candidate recall and strong ranking quality with compact history inputs.
blocks.zh: 在拉兹塞克,CRIM NDCG@50和NDCG@100排名第二,分别为0.2430和0.2614,而Qune3-Embedding-4B排名分别为0.2458和0.2620。 稠密的参考线索为Recall@10,以0.3390对0.3204的CRIM. CRIM将更高的候选人召回和强烈的排名质量与紧凑的历史投入相结合.

blocks.en: On Qilin, Recall@10 improves over Qwen3-Embedding-4B from 0.5801 to 0.5845, while GTE-1.5B achieves 0.5969. CRIM’s Recall@100 is 0.7458, compared with 0.7592 for Qwen3-Embedding-4B. Its main benefit on Qilin is therefore better target ranking, complementing the broader-cutoff recall gains observed on LazSeq.
blocks.zh: 在Qilin上,Recall@10改进了Qune3-Embedding-4B从0.5801到0.5845,而GTE-1.5B则实现0.5969. CRIM的Recall@100为0.7458,而Qune3-Embedding-4B为0.7592. 因此,它对Qilin的主要好处是更好的目标排名,补充了在LazSeq观察到的更广泛的禁产召回成果。
